_comment: Reviewed TEMPLATE of the PodInstallationPreparation input to Relay's scripts/prepare-pod-installation.ts for the first researcher installation (docs/runbooks/relay-researcher-installation.md, step I4). Every value that is not an OPERATOR-FILLS string is decided by this review and must reach the tool unchanged; scripts/relay-researcher-bundle.py check compares the bundle's 00-definition.json with this file and refuses any difference outside the OPERATOR-FILLS leaves. Remove this _comment key from the operator's copy: the tool's schema is strict.
sourceCommit: OPERATOR-FILLS: the reviewer-merged 40-hex Relay commit (= kubernetes/apps/relay-researcher/pins sourceCommit)
agentImage: OPERATOR-FILLS: publication.image of the agent's publish.py receipt (= pins agentImage)

identity.installationId: OPERATOR-FILLS: from the approval receipt (= pins installationId)
identity.installationPublicKey: OPERATOR-FILLS: raw base64url Ed25519 public half of the installation key, as approved

installationPolicy.allowedImageDigests: OPERATOR-FILLS: [the worker runtime image digest from its publish.py receipt]

binding: OPERATOR-FILLS: the release's PodRuntimeBinding (runtime manifest + image, sealed researcher template, identities, placements). Its researcher placement must be {tier, binding, runtimeClassName: relay-gvisor, overhead {milliCpu 80, memoryMiB 24}, nodeSelector including kubernetes.io/hostname: relay-worker-1 and ailab.io/relay-worker-pool: "true", tolerations [dedicated=relay-worker:NoSchedule]}; its policyDigest must be Relay contentDigest("relay.infrastructure/v1/installation-policy", installationPolicy) of THIS file's installationPolicy, so the ceilings above are part of the binding
